triggers.name: new_classification_record
triggers.title: New classification record
triggers.help: Triggers when a record without date fields is created in NetSuite. These records (Billing account, Email template, Subscription, Price book, etc.) lack created/modified date fields, so polling is done by internal ID. You can add filters using a search query or input fields. Do not filter by id — it …

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: ns_classification_object
input.label: Record type
input.hint: Select the NetSuite classification record type to monitor

input.name: since_id
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from ID
input.hint: When you start recipe for the first time, it picks up records with ID greater than this value. Leave empty to start from ID 0.

input.hint: Provide a search query to filter records. Example: name CONTAIN test . Do not filter by id — this field is managed by the trigger.

input.label: Search settings

properties.name: string_fields_operator
properties.label: String fields
properties.hint: Select the search operator for all String fields. Default is CONTAIN .

properties.name: number_fields_operator
properties.label: Number fields
properties.hint: Select the search operator for all Integer, Number, Float, Double, Duration fields. Default is EQUAL .

triggers.name: new_custom_record
triggers.title: New custom record
triggers.help: Triggers when a custom record is created in NetSuite. Choose a polling strategy: By internal ID always works; By created date requires enabling 'Show Created Date' on the custom record type in NetSuite (Customization > Records > Record Types).

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

triggers.name: new_record
triggers.title: New standard record
triggers.help: Triggers when a standard record is created in NetSuite. Polls by the record's creation date field. You can add filters using a search query or input fields. Do not filter by the date field used for polling — it is managed by the trigger.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

triggers.name: new_updated_custom_record
triggers.title: New or updated custom record
triggers.description: New or updated custom record in NetSuite
triggers.help: Triggers when a custom record is created or updated in NetSuite. Polls by the lastmodified field. Requires enabling 'Show Last Modified' on the custom record type in NetSuite (Customization > Records > Record Types).

actions.name: attach_contact_to_record

input.name: ns_object
input.label: Record
input.hint: Select a NetSuite record to perform. Only REST Web Services Supported Records are shown in the picklist, toggle to use any custom records.

input.name: id
input.label: Internal ID
input.hint: Internal ID of the record to attach the contact to.

input.name: attached_id
input.label: Contact ID
input.hint: Internal ID of the contact to attach.

input.name: role
input.label: Contact role ID
input.hint: Internal ID of the contact role to assign to the contact. Find it under Setup > Company > Contact Roles (Internal ID column).

input.label: Record
input.hint: Select a NetSuite record to perform. Only REST Web Services Supported Records are shown in the picklist, toggle to use any custom records.

input.name: id
input.label: Internal ID
input.hint: Internal ID of the record to attach the file to.

input.name: attached_id
input.label: File ID
input.hint: Internal ID of an existing File Cabinet file to attach. This links a file already in NetSuite; it does not upload file contents.
